name: Jia Hua OMS Database Knowledge

clarion_date.meaning: Days offset from Clarion epoch. Backend converts between ISO yyyy-mm-dd and OMS integer dates.

clarion_time.meaning: Hundredths-of-second style OMS time integer generated from current time.

strings.note: Most OMS char/varchar fields should be trimmed on read and clipped to field length on write.

money_and_quantity.note: OMS commonly stores money and quantities as decimal fields. Convert with Decimal/float carefully and round only for display.

key_columns.SHIP_CUS_NM: Default shipping name if separate from billing.
key_columns.TERMS_DESC: Terms display text, for example COD Cash.

read_patterns: Search by CUS_ID, phone, or matching customer text.
After selecting a customer, load full customer record and use CUS_TYPE for item pricing.

chn_str.purpose: Chain store / multi ship-to store list for one customer.
chn_str.business_rule: If customer has multiple stores, user chooses a store; selected store becomes order ship-to and STORE_NUM.

key_columns.UNIT_COLOR: Used by current app as showroom location.
key_columns.PRICE_1: Price level 1 display field if present.
key_columns.PRICE_2: Price level 2 display field if present.
key_columns.PRICE_3: Price level 3 display field if present.
key_columns.PRICE_4: Price level 4 display field if present.
key_columns.PRICE_5: Price level 5 display field if present.

inv_upc.lookup_rule: Barcode lookup should check inv.PROD_CD, inv.UPC_CD, and inv_upc.UPC_CD.

inv_data.purpose: Inventory quantity by product and warehouse.

key_columns.WHS_NUM: Warehouse number, current order entry uses warehouse 1.

inv_data.write_rule: When sales order lines are inserted/updated/deleted, adjust ORDER_QTY in inv_data inside the same transaction.

key_columns.ORD_DT: Order date in Clarion date integer.
key_columns.SHIP_DT: Ship date in Clarion date integer.
key_columns.PAID_AMT: Paid amount, usually 0 for current web orders.
key_columns.SOLD_TO: Current web app writes 'Order by IPad' for iPad-origin orders.
key_columns.SP_CUS_NM: Current web app leaves blank for new iPad-origin orders.

orders.read_rule: Order header is read from orders and joined to customer for display fallback fields.

key_columns.Id: Identity primary key for line row.
key_columns.SHIP_DT: Line ship date in Clarion date integer.
key_columns.OLG_DT: Log/order date in Clarion date integer.

ord_log.write_rule: For edits, existing ord_log rows are updated/deleted/inserted to match the submitted line list.

so_divs.write_rule: Ensure a row exists for new order. Current app updates or inserts by ORD_NUM.

order2e.purpose: Order extension table with many extra fields.
order2e.write_rule: Ensure extension row exists; update PO_NUM on edits.

cus_invt.purpose: Customer product purchase history and customer/product price history.
cus_invt.usage: Used for Customer Detail purchase history/search.

usage: Sales/user-like lookup in older versions. Current frontend sales dropdown is hard-coded.

candidate_generation: if numeric length >= 12: remove last digit/check digit
if numeric and starts with 0: remove the first 0
if numeric starts with 0 and length > 12: remove first 0 and last digit

on_success.existing_line: Increment quantity by 1 and recalculate extAmount.
on_success.new_line: Add line with quantity 1, warehouse 1, product description, pack, unit, tax indicator, selected customer price, available W1 quantity.

pricing.example_known_behavior: Customer 7186639333 is level/type 4; item 254694 should price at 16.5 instead of level 1 price 17.95.

customer_ship_to_logic.case_1_billing_only: If customer has no separate shipping fields and no selected chain store, use billing address as ship-to.
customer_ship_to_logic.case_2_shipping_address: If customer has shipping fields, use those as default ship-to.
customer_ship_to_logic.case_3_chain_stores: If chn_str has multiple stores, user selects a store; use selected store name/address/phone and write STORE_NUM.
customer_ship_to_logic.example_reference_order: 3003 can be used to compare legacy OMS ship-to/store behavior.

sales_order_number_assignment.rule: New order stays Draft until Save. On save, search from min number upward for first usable S/O number.
sales_order_number_assignment.note: Do not require using max(ORD_NUM)+1. Missing/non-contiguous numbers can be reused if required OMS rows are absent.

locks: Use SQL Server application locks for new S/O number assignment.
Use SQL Server application locks for editing existing order.
Use UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK when checking affected order/inventory rows.
new_order_write_sequence: Validate app write flags and production write acknowledgement.
edit_order_write_sequence: For removed lines: reverse inv_data.ORDER_QTY and delete ord_log row.
For changed lines: adjust inv_data.ORDER_QTY difference and update ord_log.
For new lines: insert ord_log and add inv_data.ORDER_QTY.
write_transaction_rules.rollback_rule: Any failure rolls back all header, line, extension, and inventory-reservation changes.

important_cautions: Do not run write tests against production without explicit flags and current backup/rollback plan.
Do not assume max(ORD_NUM)+1 is the next order number; search for first usable candidate.
Do not ignore order2e or so_divs; legacy OMS expects companion rows.
When changing lines, update inv_data.ORDER_QTY atomically with ord_log changes.
Trim fixed-width char fields on read; clip values to known field lengths on write.
Do not commit backend/.env, production snapshots, database backups, or generated PDFs.
Keep frontend database access indirect through backend APIs.
